paragraphs: Mar son of Rav Ashi. Rav Assi visited Rav Assi's house—Amsterdam printing: Rav Ashi's house—at Mar son of Rav Ashi's wedding, Ketubbot 8a. It seems he was the early Rav Ashi's son, as I write shortly below (see above, Mar Kashisha son of Rav Ḥisda). She'erit Yosef counted him among Rav's students. He certainly means the early figure, who was grown in Rav's days; but where he derived his studenthood requires examination.
